name: Gasthof Kienbergklamm
beschreibung:
Situated at the entrance to the dramatic Kienbergklamm gorge near Kufstein, this welcoming alpine inn provides comfortable dining spaces and guestrooms along with flavoursome local specialities.

The gorge walking trail, Lake Hechtsee, and Kufstein Fortress are only a short distance away.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Kienbergklamm near Kufstein pairs romantic natural scenery with hearty Tyrolean cuisine.
